scientific_limitations: The exact 16-state symbolic factorization has a complete standalone integer-arithmetic verifier; no independent review has occurred. Priority remains bibliographically uncertain. The graph family is restricted to Möbius ladders of order at least six.
title: The 1-limited domination polynomial and exact minima of Möbius ladders
